import { Haptics, ImpactStyle, NotificationType } from '@capacitor/haptics';

interface SoundProfile {
    type: 'sine' | 'square' | 'triangle' | 'sawtooth';
    uiClickFreq: number;
    uiTapFreq: number;
    numberFreqs: number[];
    popFreq: number;
    durationScale: number;
    volumeScale: number;
}

const PROFILES: Record<string, SoundProfile> = {
    'snd-zen': {
        type: 'sine',
        uiClickFreq: 800,
        uiTapFreq: 600,
        numberFreqs: [523.25, 587.33, 659.25, 783.99, 880.00, 1046.50, 1174.66, 1318.51, 1567.98],
        popFreq: 400,
        durationScale: 1.0,
        volumeScale: 1.0
    },
    'snd-retro': {
        type: 'square',
        uiClickFreq: 1200,
        uiTapFreq: 1000,
        numberFreqs: [440, 493.88, 554.37, 587.33, 659.25, 739.99, 830.61, 880, 987.77],
        popFreq: 300,
        durationScale: 0.7,
        volumeScale: 0.25 // Squares are very harmonic and loud
    }
};

class SoundController {
    private ctx: AudioContext | null = null;
    private soundEnabled: boolean = true;
    private vibrationEnabled: boolean = true;
    private activeProfile: SoundProfile = PROFILES['snd-zen'];

    setEnabled(enabled: boolean) {
        this.soundEnabled = enabled;
    }

    setVibrationEnabled(enabled: boolean) {
        this.vibrationEnabled = enabled;
    }

    setProfile(profileId: string) {
        if (PROFILES[profileId]) {
            this.activeProfile = PROFILES[profileId];
        } else {
            // Default fallback
            this.activeProfile = PROFILES['snd-zen'];
        }
    }

    private getCtx() {
        if (!this.ctx) {
            const AudioContext = window.AudioContext || (window as any).webkitAudioContext;
            this.ctx = new AudioContext();
        }
        if (this.ctx.state === 'suspended') {
            this.ctx.resume().catch(() => {});
        }
        return this.ctx;
    }

    private async vibrate(style: 'light' | 'medium' | 'heavy' | 'success' | 'warning' | 'error') {
        if (!this.vibrationEnabled) return;
        try {
            switch (style) {
                case 'light': await Haptics.impact({ style: ImpactStyle.Light }); break;
                case 'medium': await Haptics.impact({ style: ImpactStyle.Medium }); break;
                case 'heavy': await Haptics.impact({ style: ImpactStyle.Heavy }); break;
                case 'success': await Haptics.notification({ type: NotificationType.Success }); break;
                case 'warning': await Haptics.notification({ type: NotificationType.Warning }); break;
                case 'error': await Haptics.notification({ type: NotificationType.Error }); break;
            }
        } catch (e) {
            if (typeof navigator !== 'undefined' && navigator.vibrate) {
                const map: Record<string, number | number[]> = {
                    light: 10,
                    medium: 20,
                    heavy: 40,
                    success: [50, 50, 100],
                    warning: [30, 100],
                    error: [50, 100, 50]
                };
                navigator.vibrate(map[style]);
            }
        }
    }

    private playTone(freq: number, type: 'sine' | 'triangle' | 'square' | 'sawtooth', duration: number, volume: number) {
        if (!this.soundEnabled) return;
        try {
            const ctx = this.getCtx();
            const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
            const gain = ctx.createGain();
            
            osc.connect(gain);
            gain.connect(ctx.destination);
            
            osc.type = type;
            osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, ctx.currentTime);
            
            const t = ctx.currentTime;
            const attack = 0.01;
            
            gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0, t);
            gain.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(volume * this.activeProfile.volumeScale, t + attack);
            gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, t + (duration * this.activeProfile.durationScale));
            
            osc.start(t);
            osc.stop(t + (duration * this.activeProfile.durationScale) + 0.05);
        } catch (e) {}
    }

    playClick() {
        this.vibrate('light'); 
        this.playTone(this.activeProfile.uiClickFreq, this.activeProfile.type, 0.1, 0.5); 
    }

    playTap() {
        this.vibrate('light');
        this.playTone(this.activeProfile.uiTapFreq, this.activeProfile.type, 0.1, 0.5); 
    }

    playNumber(num: number) {
        this.vibrate('medium');
        const freq = this.activeProfile.numberFreqs[num - 1] || 440;
        this.playTone(freq, this.activeProfile.type, 0.15, 0.8); 
    }

    playPop() {
        this.vibrate('medium');
        this.playTone(this.activeProfile.popFreq, this.activeProfile.type, 0.15, 0.8); 
    }
    
    playLevelEnter() {
        this.vibrate('heavy');
        if (!this.soundEnabled) return;
        try {
            const ctx = this.getCtx();
            const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
            const gain = ctx.createGain();
            osc.connect(gain);
            gain.connect(ctx.destination);
            osc.type = this.activeProfile.type;
            const t = ctx.currentTime;
            osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(this.activeProfile.popFreq, t); 
            osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(this.activeProfile.uiClickFreq, t + 0.2);
            gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0, t);
            gain.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0.8 * this.activeProfile.volumeScale, t + 0.05);
            gain.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0.6 * this.activeProfile.volumeScale, t + 0.15);
            gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, t + 0.3);
            osc.start(t);
            osc.stop(t + 0.3);
        } catch (e) {}
    }
    
    playSectionComplete() {
        this.vibrate('success');
        if (!this.soundEnabled) return;
        try {
            const freqs = this.activeProfile.numberFreqs;
            const notes = [freqs[0], freqs[2], freqs[4]]; 
            notes.forEach((freq, i) => {
                setTimeout(() => this.playTone(freq, this.activeProfile.type, 0.1, 0.5), i * 50); 
            });
        } catch (e) {}
    }

    playZap() {
        this.vibrate('medium');
        if (!this.soundEnabled) return;
        try {
            const ctx = this.getCtx();
            const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
            const gain = ctx.createGain();
            osc.connect(gain);
            gain.connect(ctx.destination);
            osc.type = this.activeProfile.type;
            const t = ctx.currentTime;
            osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(1200, t);
            osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(600, t + 0.15);
            gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0, t);
            gain.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0.8 * this.activeProfile.volumeScale, t + 0.01);
            gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, t + 0.15);
            osc.start(t);
            osc.stop(t + 0.2);
        } catch (e) {}
    }
    
    playScan() {
        this.vibrate('heavy');
        if (!this.soundEnabled) return;
        try {
            const ctx = this.getCtx();
            const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
            const gain = ctx.createGain();
            osc.connect(gain);
            gain.connect(ctx.destination);
            osc.type = this.activeProfile.type === 'sine' ? 'triangle' : 'sawtooth';
            const t = ctx.currentTime;
            osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(200, t);
            osc.frequency.linearRampToValueAtTime(800, t + 0.8);
            gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0, t);
            gain.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0.5 * this.activeProfile.volumeScale, t + 0.1);
            gain.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0.5 * this.activeProfile.volumeScale, t + 0.6);
            gain.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0, t + 0.8);
            osc.start(t);
            osc.stop(t + 0.8);
        } catch (e) {}
    }

    playReveal() {
        this.vibrate('heavy');
        if (!this.soundEnabled) return;
        try {
            const ctx = this.getCtx();
            const t = ctx.currentTime;
            const freqs = [329.63, 415.30, 493.88, 622.25, 739.99]; 
            freqs.forEach((freq, i) => {
                const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
                const gain = ctx.createGain();
                osc.connect(gain);
                gain.connect(ctx.destination);
                osc.type = this.activeProfile.type;
                osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, t);
                const start = t + (i * 0.04);
                gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0, start);
                gain.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0.5 * this.activeProfile.volumeScale, start + 0.05);
                gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, start + 2.0);
                osc.start(start);
                osc.stop(start + 2.0);
            });
        } catch (e) {}
    }

    playWin() {
        this.vibrate('success');
        if (!this.soundEnabled) return;
        const freqs = this.activeProfile.numberFreqs;
        const notes = [freqs[0], freqs[2], freqs[4], freqs[5]]; 
        notes.forEach((freq, i) => {
            setTimeout(() => {
                this.playTone(freq, this.activeProfile.type, 0.6, 0.7);
            }, i * 100);
        });
    }
}

        cost = Math.round(increased / 10) * 10;

    const isPack2Unlocked = unlockedPacks2.includes(difficulty);
    const isPack3Unlocked = unlockedPacks3.includes(difficulty);

    if (isPack2Unlocked) totalVisibleLevels = 200;
    if (isPack3Unlocked) totalVisibleLevels = 300;

    // Count completed levels for specific ranges to drive unlock cards
    const completedRange1 = Storage.getCompletedCountInRange(difficulty, 1, 100);
    const completedRange2 = Storage.getCompletedCountInRange(difficulty, 101, 200);

    // Global Best for Header
    let globalBest = Infinity;
    allLevels.forEach(l => {
        const p = Storage.getLevelProgress(difficulty, l);
        if (p?.bestTime !== undefined && p.bestTime < globalBest) {
            globalBest = p.bestTime;
        }
    });
    const hasGlobalBest = globalBest !== Infinity;

    return (

                <button onClick={() => { sounds.playClick(); onOpenSettings(); }} className="absolute right-6 top-[20px] p-2 rounded-full hover:bg-stone-200 -mr-2"><Icons.Settings className="w-6 h-6 text-t-icon" /></button>

                <div className="w-full max-w-md grid grid-cols-5 gap-3">

                            const bestTime = progress?.bestTime;
                            const isGlobalBest = hasGlobalBest && bestTime !== undefined && bestTime === globalBest;

                            return (
                                <button key={lvl} onClick={() => onLevelSelect(lvl)} className={`aspect-square rounded-xl relative transition-all active:scale-90 ${isCompleted ? 'bg-t-surface-sec text-t-secondary border border-t-border ring-1 ring-inset ring-stone-900/5' : isInProgress ? 'bg-t-surface border-2 border-blue-400 shadow-md text-t-primary' : 'bg-t-surface border border-t-border shadow-sm hover:shadow-md text-t-primary'}`}>
                                    <div className="absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center"><span className="font-bold text-2xl leading-none">{lvl}</span></div>
                                    {bestTime ? (
                                        isGlobalBest ? (
                                            <>
                                                <div className="absolute top-1.5 inset-x-0 flex justify-center">
                                                    <span className="text-[8px] font-black text-amber-500 tracking-widest opacity-90 animate-pulse">BEST</span>

                                                    <span className="text-[10px] text-amber-500 font-bold tracking-tight block leading-none animate-pulse">{formatTimeShort(bestTime)}</span>

                                                <span className="text-[10px] text-t-secondary font-bold tracking-tight block">{formatTimeShort(bestTime)}</span>

                                </button>

                        endLevel={200}

                        endLevel={300}

                        totalBaseLevels={100}
                        cost={getPackCost(difficulty, 3)}
                        onUnlock={onUnlockPack3}
                    />
                )}

                <div className="h-safe-bottom w-full shrink-0" />
            </div>
        </div>
    );
